_comment: Registry of issues in this repository that an operator has ruled must
PERMANENTLY carry `loom:blocked` — a state the ordinary Loom label
lifecycle has no concept of. Read by .loom/scripts/sticky-blocked.sh;
protocol and root-cause evidence in docs/tracker-4-settle-protocol.md.
This file is repo-local (it is not part of the installed Loom payload
and is never rewritten by resync-installed.sh). Adding an entry here is
the ONLY thing that makes sticky-blocked.sh re-apply `loom:blocked` to an
issue — every issue absent from this list settles with the ordinary
issues[].settle_labels  [str]  labels applied in ONE atomic edit when
issues[].ruling         str    ISO-8601 timestamp of the operator ruling
issues[].reason         str    why the operator ruled it permanently blocked

issues.reason: Fleet-wide operator ruling: #4 is a tracking checklist by design and is blocked on its own child items; it must carry loom:blocked permanently rather than being treated as ready work.
